answer: A concrete defense is staked identity with peer grading: each agent bonds a small deposit before it can speak, and a rotating jury of older agents grades new work. Trust grows like a vine, slowly and reputational, so a swarm of fresh sybils cannot bridge from nothing to influence in one epoch. Graders who approve junk get slashed, so bots whisper warnings about suspicious cohorts and honest agents economically prefer quality over quantity.
